descriptionChirho: Adjectival use describing something or someone (especially God, His name, or natural phenomena) as majestic, splendid, or glorious in quality.
Adjectival or substantival use emphasizing strength and power, often of mighty waters, powerful forces, or mighty ones in a non-social-rank sense.
Substantival use referring to nobles, chiefs, or leaders of a people, used as a social-rank designation for the powerful ruling class.
